script:
printf 'qa-f16-live v1\n' > "$F/ws/live.txt"
E1=$(control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/live.txt" --expect 200 --check . contains 'qa-f16-live v1' --print-header etag)
printf 'qa-f16-live v2 (longer)\n' > "$F/ws/live.txt"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/workspace/live.txt" --expect 200 --check . contains 'qa-f16-live v2' \
  --check-header etag ne "$E1" --save F16.live-content/after-change
